scope: TP=8 environment snapshot and planned common configuration after container rebuild; no readiness, correctness or performance result is certified by this file.

collection.method: Read-only npu-smi, git, Python distribution metadata, /proc allowlisted native API arguments/environment, cgroup/system metadata and model metadata file reads. No torch/torch_npu import, device context creation, NPU workload, API request, or full weight-file scan.
collection.note: Log is growing; the prefix length/hash and selected lines describe only this snapshot.
collection.followup_note: Only startup log observations were extended at observed_native_startup.log_followup_at_utc; other dynamic fields retain recorded_at_utc snapshot timing.

container_resources.comparison_note: Current container CPU quota is 32 equivalent cores versus 16 in TP4. 192 allowed CPUs are scheduling affinity, not CPU quota. TP8 versus prior TP4 throughput is therefore not a controlled scaling-only comparison.

initial_state.reported_services: No vLLM API/engine/worker processes; all eight NPUs idle after container/device reconfiguration.
initial_state.note: This is an earlier same-run observation, not a claim that services remain absent at this later collection time.

distribution_notes: Distribution metadata was read without importing torch or torch_npu; installed versions do not replace source pins.
